caption: The drawing depicts a metallic scientific apparatus, composed of several cylindrical and circular elements arranged vertically and horizontally on a neutral, light-colored background. The main part of the apparatus is a vertical rod, bronze or brass in color, ending in a ring at the top and anchored by a wide, rounded base at the bottom. Attached perpendicularly to the rod via a horizontal arm is a cylindrical container, colored in various shades of brown and greenish-bronze, with a domed, capped top. To the left of the rod, another vertical cylindrical part rises from a circular stand with holes, matching the metallic tone of the rest of the device. This part features a top composed of small, upward-curved projections, resembling prongs or open petals. All components show areas of shading and highlights that indicate a reflective, somewhat polished metallic surface with occasional greenish patina. The drawing is rendered with realistic color gradations and no background elements aside from the device itself.
title: Student Lamp
